test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Someone thinks Charles should ________ the British throne and come out here instead.
solution: The correct answer is: **Abdicate** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Abdicate**" means to give up or renounce a position of power or authority, especially a throne. (सत्ता या प्राधिकार का पद छोड़ना या त्यागना, विशेषकर सिंहासन) • **Example**: *The king chose to abdicate the throne, leaving the kingdom without a ruler.* • In this context, the sentence suggests that someone thinks Charles should give up his claim to the British throne and come somewhere else instead. • Therefore, 'abdicate' is the correct word choice for the sentence. Thus, **option 2 **is the correct answer. **Complete sentence**: *Someone thinks Charles should abdicate __the British throne and come out here instead.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • The word "**reciprocate**" means to respond to a gesture or action by making a corresponding one. (किसी इशारे या क्रिया का उसके अनुरूप उत्तर देना) • The word "**decorticate**" means to remove the bark, rind, or outer layer from something. (किसी चीज़ से छाल, छिलका या बाहरी परत निकालना) • The word "**authenticate**" means to prove or confirm the validity or authenticity of something. (किसी चीज़ की वैधता या प्रामाणिकता को साबित या पुष्टि करना) 1b8:Ta48, The correct answer is: **Advancements**.
